activity.notes: Francisco de Paula Santander was elected President of New Granada in 1832 while abroad and personally assumed office on 7 October 1832 after returning to Bogotá. He served until 1 April 1837. ATLAS uses the actual assumption of office rather than the earlier acting period exercised by Vice President José Ignacio de Márquez.

sources.title: Presidency of Colombia — Francisco de Paula Santander
sources.citation_text: The Colombian presidency identifies Santander as president in 1832–1837 and explains that he exercised the first magistracy after returning from exile.

sources.title: Banco de la República Cultural Encyclopedia — Los partidos políticos en el siglo XIX
sources.citation_text: The Banco de la República states that Santander arrived back in 1832 and took possession of the presidency on 7 October.
